item.title: How to Browse a Wiki
item.text: A tutorial for people who want to read, navigate, and search a federated wiki.

item.title: How To Wiki
item.text: Here we describe how to use the web interface to the federated wiki. Read [[About Federated Wiki]] to learn about the project. If you are just starting to write in your first wiki then read the [[Field Guide to the Federation]].

item.title: How To Wiki
item.text: Here we describe how to use the web interface to the federated wiki. Read [[About Federated Wiki]] to learn about the project.

item.title: Start Playing Wiki
item.text: Wiki is a hypertext. When you click a link you will go to that page. Here we have arranged the pages like rooms in an adventure game. There are things you can do here but you can just zoom through without doing any of them. Then maybe you will play again and do some things. Play it lots of times. You will get good at it.

item.title: Start Playing Wiki
item.text: Like riding a bicycle, writing here is easy to do but hard to learn. And like the bicycle, just talking about riding doesn't really convey the experience. Try doing.
